items.text: Develop and validate hybrid quantum-classical computing systems.
Conduct research and implement quantum algorithms, simulation techniques, and noise models.
Contribute to the design and improvement of quantum computing components and supporting architectures.
Build verification and testing workflows to enhance performance and reliability.
Explore and develop quantum application cases (e.g., optimization, chemistry simulation, and machine learning) through experimentation and performance evaluation.
Participate in deployment and integration within distributed or containerized environments.
Prepare technical reports and collaborate with internal development teams.

description.text:
1. Develop and validate hybrid quantum-classical computing systems.
2. Conduct research and implement quantum algorithms, simulation techniques, and noise models.
3. Contribute to the design and improvement of quantum computing components and supporting architectures.
4. Build verification and testing workflows to enhance performance and reliability.
5. Explore and develop quantum application cases (e.g., optimization, chemistry simulation, and machine learning) through experimentation and performance evaluation.
6. Participate in deployment and integration within distributed or containerized environments.
7. Prepare technical reports and collaborate with internal development teams.

key_values.label: 工作技能
key_values.text: 軟體工程系統開發、模組化系統設計、演算法設計

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
General Requirements:
1. Background in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.
2. Proficient in Python or C++.
3. Understanding of quantum logic gates, error correction, and circuit simulation fundamentals.
4. Familiar with Linux environments, HPC systems, or control architectures.
5. Strong English communication and technical documentation skills.
6. Curiosity and ability to learn across disciplines.
Preferred Qualifications:
1. Familiar with Qiskit, Cirq, CUDA or CUDA-Q.
2. Experience with cluster scheduling or containerized environments (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes, Docker).
3. Experience with GPU or FPGA development.
4. Participation in quantum simulation or related research
5. Understanding of CPU-GPU-QPU hybrid architectures or cloud-based control systems.
